text.hi: The Supra came back in 2019 after a 17-year gap; the previous generation had ended production in 2002.
text.en: The Supra came back in 2019 after a 17-year gap; the previous generation had ended production in 2002.

text.hi: Akio Toyoda, then Toyota's president, trained as a 'master driver' in an old Supra at the Nürburgring and says he secretly wanted a new one even when Toyota had no plans for it.
text.en: Akio Toyoda, then Toyota's president, trained as a 'master driver' in an old Supra at the Nürburgring and says he secretly wanted a new one even when Toyota had no plans for it.

text.hi: It is a Toyota built in Austria: every GR Supra was made by Magna Steyr in Graz, the same contract factory that builds its cousin, the BMW Z4.
text.en: It is a Toyota built in Austria: every GR Supra was made by Magna Steyr in Graz, the same contract factory that builds its cousin, the BMW Z4.

text.hi: Toyota designed it around a 1.55 wheelbase-to-track 'golden ratio', one of the smallest among mass-production sports cars, for sharp turning. Its wheelbase is even 100 mm shorter than the Toyota 86's.
text.en: Toyota designed it around a 1.55 wheelbase-to-track 'golden ratio', one of the smallest among mass-production sports cars, for sharp turning. Its wheelbase is even 100 mm shorter than the Toyota 86's.

text.hi: The 'double-bubble' roof, borrowed from the 1967 Toyota 2000GT, is not just for looks: it cuts frontal area and drag while keeping headroom.
text.en: The 'double-bubble' roof, borrowed from the 1967 Toyota 2000GT, is not just for looks: it cuts frontal area and drag while keeping headroom.

text.hi: Its look was first previewed by the FT-1 concept car, styled at Toyota's CALTY studio in California and shown in Detroit in 2014. The design brief was just two words: 'Condensed Extreme'.
text.en: Its look was first previewed by the FT-1 concept car, styled at Toyota's CALTY studio in California and shown in Detroit in 2014. The design brief was just two words: 'Condensed Extreme'.

text.hi: Toyota says the body is stiffer than the Lexus LFA supercar, which has a carbon-fibre cabin, and up to 2.5 times stiffer than the 86.
text.en: Toyota says the body is stiffer than the Lexus LFA supercar, which has a carbon-fibre cabin, and up to 2.5 times stiffer than the 86.

text.hi: To get a perfect 50:50 weight balance, engineers pushed the engine as far back as possible, which created new production challenges.
text.en: To get a perfect 50:50 weight balance, engineers pushed the engine as far back as possible, which created new production challenges.

text.hi: The very first production GR Supra, VIN ending 20201, was auctioned at Barrett-Jackson in January 2019 for US$2.1 million, with all proceeds going to charity.
text.en: The very first production GR Supra, VIN ending 20201, was auctioned at Barrett-Jackson in January 2019 for US$2.1 million, with all proceeds going to charity.

text.hi: Only 90 'A90 Edition' cars were made for Europe at launch, in matte Storm Grey with red leather, offered to the first 90 people who pre-ordered.
text.en: Only 90 'A90 Edition' cars were made for Europe at launch, in matte Storm Grey with red leather, offered to the first 90 people who pre-ordered.

text.hi: For 2021 the engine got a new six-port exhaust manifold and lower compression, jumping from 335 to 382 hp. The changes were big enough that Toyota engineers nicknamed it the 'A91'.
text.en: For 2021 the engine got a new six-port exhaust manifold and lower compression, jumping from 335 to 382 hp. The changes were big enough that Toyota engineers nicknamed it the 'A91'.

text.hi: The 6-speed manual (2023) was engineered specifically for the Supra, right down to a 200-gram gear knob, and it auto rev-matches on downshifts.
text.en: The 6-speed manual (2023) was engineered specifically for the Supra, right down to a 200-gram gear knob, and it auto rev-matches on downshifts.

text.hi: The 2024 45th Anniversary Edition came in 'Mikan Blast' orange (mikan means orange in Japanese), a tribute to the Mk4 Supra 'of big-screen fame'. That film car was the older Mk4, not this A90.
text.en: The 2024 45th Anniversary Edition came in 'Mikan Blast' orange (mikan means orange in Japanese), a tribute to the Mk4 Supra 'of big-screen fame'. That film car was the older Mk4, not this A90.

text.hi: The A90 Final Edition makes 441 PS and 571 Nm, uses a swan-neck carbon wing, KW suspension and Recaro carbon seats, is limited to 300 cars, and cost ¥15 million in Japan.
text.en: The A90 Final Edition makes 441 PS and 571 Nm, uses a swan-neck carbon wing, KW suspension and Recaro carbon seats, is limited to 300 cars, and cost ¥15 million in Japan.

text.hi: German magazine Sport Auto lapped the Nürburgring Nordschleife in a 2020 GR Supra on standard tyres in 7 min 52.17 s.
text.en: German magazine Sport Auto lapped the Nürburgring Nordschleife in a 2020 GR Supra on standard tyres in 7 min 52.17 s.

rarity: Produced for about seven years (March 2019 – March 2026). Special editions were tiny: 90 A90 Editions (Europe), 300 A90 Final Editions (Japan + Europe), and a single 'Global #1' car. Never officially sold in India.

summary.hi: The fifth-generation Supra (Mk5, code J29/DB, marketed as A90) brought the famous name back in 2019 after a 17-year break. Toyota GAZOO Racing developed it together with BMW, which also builds the Z4 on the same platform, and both cars were made by Magna Steyr in Graz, Austria. Its 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-six sends power to the rear wheels, it has 50:50 weight balance, and its double-bubble roof is a nod to the classic Toyota 2000GT. Production ended in March 2026.
